title: webhooks.normalize_event_types
description: Stored form and validity of a webhook endpoint's event-type filter on creation (BE-WH-4, BE-WH-5). A non-empty array is normalised: each element to text, trimmed, lower-cased; blank/null elements dropped; duplicates removed keeping the first occurrence; exactly ["*"] after that becomes null (receive everything). Then validation: null is valid; a string is parsed as a PostgreSQL array literal: at least one element ('{a,b}') -> that list, normalised and validated; no element ('', 'wrong', '{}') -> error 'must_be_array'; a JSON number or boolean is an unhandled failure at the pin (kit error code server_error); any element that is not a configured event name -> error 'contains invalid types: <JSON-style list of the offending elements>' (so '*' next to other names is invalid). An empty array (or one that normalises to empty) is stored as [] and silences the endpoint.

event_types_json.description: JSON text of the submitted event_types value (array, string, number or null).
